evidence.primaryVideoName: Apple Music Player Controls Collapse Interaction
evidence.originalDescription: This interaction demonstrates the fluid dismissal of the full-screen music player queue. The user initiates a downward drag on the player sheet. The entire modal panel slides down smoothly, tracking the gesture with high responsiveness. As the panel moves downward, the background content behind it scales up slightly and loses its dimming overlay, creating a seamless spatial transition. If released past the threshold, the sheet snaps off-screen with a natural spring-loaded deceleration, returning the user to the main library view.
